title: The Endif

== Introduction ==
The idea was nice but the groups were pretty weird divided. In bracket A we saw Camel winning 2-1 of [[Xantom]] in the final while in bracket B [[UL]] took out [[Molle]] 2-0 in one semi while [[Inter]] won [[Arnette]] 2-0 in the other. After that [[UL]] took [[Inter]] out 2-0 kicking him out of the tournament. In Bracket C [[Kzuu]] won the final 2-0 of [[Faustov]] giving a final of [[UL]], [[Kzuu]] and [[Camel]]. The final wasn't very hard for UL, he won both his games 3-0, Camel and kzuu didn't even play their game. Other players that were kicked out earlier in the tournament were [[Murdoc]] and [[Vladde]].
